snippet.title: Stickility - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419140/Stickility/


Welcome to Stickility, a 2D metroidvania, where you'll explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center, brimming with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Craft your equipment from scavenged tech, and uncover Biotec's dark experiments. 

Inspired by famous indie titles like Hollow Knight, Crowsworn, HAAK, and more.

Official Discord server - https://discord.gg/ttQPJCdFFJ
